semiconductor_relevance: High — SuperPlus TECH provides specialized equipment crucial for wafer handling and identification in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: SuperPlus TECH specializes in assembly and process equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on conveying and transfer systems for wafer handling. The company also develops marking equipment for wafer identification and reticles or flat panel displays, enhancing production efficiency and warehouse utilization.
capabilities: Transfer systems for wafer and reticle handling
Solutions for flat panel display handling

regional_presence.Taiwan: SuperPlus TECH has expanded its operations with a new 3500-ping assembly space in Zhudong to meet growing industry demands.
